adopt.title: Adopt Noticom node
adopt.description: Adopt node **{node_id}**? Give it a name, then press Submit: the node chirps, and you have 60 seconds to press its button to confirm.

data_description.name: Usually the room it's in, e.g. Kitchen.

user.title: Add a Noticom node
user.description: Nodes on your network usually appear automatically under Discovered. If one doesn't, enter its IP address (run hostname -I on the Pi, or look for "advertising as … on <address>" in its log).

error.button_timeout: The node's button wasn't pressed within 60 seconds. Try again.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the node. If you reinstalled or reflashed this Pi, this card may be left over from before and point at an old address: close it, click Ignore on any older Noticom cards, and add the node with Add integration → Noticom using the address from `hostname -I` on the Pi.
error.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no local URL configured (Settings → System → Network).
error.unreachable: No unclaimed Noticom node answered at that address. Check that the node software is running and the node isn't already adopted (a node adopted by another Home Assistant needs a factory reset first).

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered node didn't report a node ID.

init.title: Button
init.description: How this node's button is wired. The node restarts to apply a change.

data_description.button_pin: BCM GPIO number. 13 is on the ReSpeaker HAT's Grove connector; 17 is its onboard button. Use 0 if this node has no button (pair and reset it with sudo noticom-node pair / reset).
data_description.button_nc: Turn on if the pin reads high when the button is pressed (normally closed). Most buttons are normally open.

play_chime.name: Play chime
play_chime.description: Plays a chime on Noticom nodes. Target nodes, or leave the target empty to play on all of them.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Chime name: a file name from /config/noticom/chimes without its extension, e.g. doorbell for doorbell.mp3.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops playback and clears the queue on Noticom nodes (all of them if no target).

reload_chimes.name: Reload chimes
reload_chimes.description: Rescans /config/noticom/chimes now instead of waiting for the next automatic scan.
